title: Fast Travel Config
description: Configuration schema for Fast Travel v2 — defines commands, groups, routes, and patterns. Both clients (browser extension and Android app) validate against this schema on every config load.

version.description: Major schema version. Bump for breaking changes; clients refuse versions they don't recognise.

defaultCommand.description: Trigger of the command to use when no command matches the input. Must match a trigger of some command in `groups`.

defaultSuggestionsApi.description: URL template for default autocomplete suggestions. Must be https? and contain {query}.

defaultLuckyUrl.description: Ctrl+Enter 'I'm Feeling Lucky'-style URL template used by the default search (e.g. Google's &btnI). Must be https? and contain {query}.

ignoreList.description: Default list of strings to ignore in typo detection (in addition to the bundled common-words list).

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; must start and end with [a-z0-9].

color.description: Optional hex color used to tint chips/badges for commands in this group

description.description: Optional human-readable description shown in the settings UI.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; must start and end with [a-z0-9]. Used by fixtures and analytics — do not rename casually.

triggers.description: Command triggers (first is primary, rest are aliases). Must not contain whitespace.

type.description: standard: exact or search; prefix: startsWith match using {term}; redirect: exact match only, no search or suggestions (falls through to default command when args follow).

description.description: Optional one-line description shown in the settings UI.

color.description: Optional per-command color override (defaults to the group color).

iconUrl.description: URL for the command's icon image (e.g. favicon). Must be https? to avoid mixed-content.

iconOverrides.description: Optional per-device icon overrides. Each device may appear in at most one entry (semantic check, not enforced by JSON Schema).

suggestionsApi.description: URL template for command-specific autocomplete. Must be https? and contain {query}.

normalize.description: Optional ordered pipeline of transforms applied to the args string before pattern matching and {query} substitution. Steps: trim, collapseSpaces, stripSpaces, lower, upper, snake (whitespace→_ and lowercase), camel (whitespace removed and next char uppercased; first char lowercased).

browsers.description: Optional browser restriction; route matches only when the current browser is in this list.

defaultUrl.description: URL to navigate to when command is used without arguments. Allowed schemes: http, https, mailto, tel, file. (Android resolver further restricts to http/https/mailto/tel.)

searchUrl.description: Optional URL template for search queries. Allowed schemes as for defaultUrl. Use {query} for standard or {term}/{query} for prefix; if no placeholder is present, the URL is opened verbatim ignoring args.

match.description: Pattern string with optional {placeholder} markers (e.g. 'r/{subreddit}'). Placeholder names must be unique within a single match. Length-constrained forms: {name:N} for exactly N non-whitespace/non-slash chars; {name:N-M} for a range.

url.description: URL template with the same {placeholder} markers as match. Each URL placeholder must appear in the match string.
